title: The crash screen and the Couldn't save line give no way to ask for help
what: When a screen crashes, the member sees only Try again, Go back and Go to Workout. When saving keeps failing, the line over every screen says to free some space and has no button at all. Neither offers Help and feedback or any way to tell MettleUp what happened, so a member stuck on a screen that crashes every time, or whose saves keep failing after freeing space, has to find the help box in Settings on their own. The crash itself is reported to MettleUp automatically, but without the member's words.
expected: The crash screen, and the Couldn't save line once it has stayed a while, offer a Get help or Tell us what happened button that opens Help and feedback.
fix_line: Add a Get help button to the crash screen and to a long-standing save problem that opens Help and feedback

title: Member help says nothing about the update screen, save problems, the crash screen or the Charts page's newer parts
what: The AI help answers only from the help articles. No member article mentions the full-screen 'A new MettleUp is here' with Update now, the watch app update pop-up, the 'Couldn't save' line, or the crash screen. The progress article says Charts shows 'your last 7 days, sets for each muscle group, and your main exercises', but the Charts page also has the body map with a 7, 30 or 90 day switch, the Balance check card and the Strength score with Add body weight. A member who asks about any of these gets no answer, or a partial one.
expected: The member help explains updating the app (phone and watch), what to do when saving fails or a screen crashes, and each card on the Charts page.
how_often: every member who asks help about these
fix_line: Add member help lines for app updates, save problems, the crash screen and the Charts page cards
